He is 2.08 m (6 ft 10 in) tall. He currently plays with the pro club [[Pamesa Valencia]]. ==Pro career== Claver began his playing career with the youth teams of CD Maristas and Pamesa Valencia in Spain. He made his professional debut with Pamesa Valencia's farm team, Pamesa Valenica 2, during the 2005-06 season. He moved up to the [[Liga ACB|Spanish ACB League]] for the first time during the 2006-07 season, when he debuted with the senior team of [[Pamesa Valencia]].
